source_review: Runtime identity is full structural Type::Enum with the exact reserved marker and ordinal MemberN labels, not marker-only or shortened-hash identity. Analyze and Verify independently enforce family, arity, labels, flattening, resolved ordinary member identity and strict full-Type ordering.

CT canonicalization builds explicit complete constructor keys containing nominal symbol, generation identity, generic arguments and scalar bits. It normalizes DAG numbering/sharing and member order; checked node, temporary byte, generated node, comparison and depth bounds precede copied constructor expansion.

The CT-to-runtime bridge resolves and sorts complete runtime members again. It does not copy CT member indexes into runtime tags. Phantom nominal generic arguments, reordered declarations, imported aliases, generic T member patterns and nested unsigned/float Enum layouts are exercised.

Generic member pattern substitutions are retained in private declaration-generated maps and full types. Raw canonical attacks independently fail Analyze, Verify and decoded-Wire Verify; source duplicate, inexact injection, nonexhaustive/repeated patterns and duplicate concrete generic members reject.
